text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain's industrial zones are to be organised as part of a plan to attract investment and create jobs for Bahrainis, official says.
- Around 15 countries to join a Productive Families Projects exhibition to be held in Bahrain in April.
- Bahrain to host the 10th Middle East Oil exhibition and conference next month.
- Shares worth 8.99 million dinars were traded in Bahrain Stock Market last month.
- Bahrain celebrates 29th anniversary of its Defence Force on Wednesday.
